correctness.rationale: With two terminal constants, unary distance-at-most-r predicates are built by alternating only x,y and reusing bound variable names. For shortest terminal distance a>=2, a strict distance difference <a implies both distances follow the direct path; the midpoint predicate (floor(L/2),ceil(L/2)) then picks exactly one vertex on each path of length L. Existence of one or two witnesses recovers each length multiplicity because there are exactly three paths. Equal multisets give isomorphism. Without named terminals each vertex has both a distinct neighbor and a distinct nonneighbor, enabling an indefinite two-pebble partial-isomorphism response and a common FO2 theory. Partition counting yields floor((N²-6N+12)/12), and the named FO1 lower bound uses Θ(4,4,4),Θ(5,5,5). Independently checked 960 midpoint multiplicities by BFS.
residual_risks: Only three paths each of length >=2, distinct named terminals and no counting quantifiers; not a characterization of all bounded-treewidth graphs.

evidence: Pikhurko–Verbitsky gives general pebble-game and distance definability results; Benakli et al classifies metric resolving properties on theta graphs.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General metric definitions do not alone imply this FO2 midpoint-multiplicity classification; one must exploit fixed terminal constants and exactly three paths. An uninspected general named series-parallel logical theorem could still cover it.

value.rationale: This is an exact expressive-power boundary on a natural minimal series-parallel network: two distinguished terminals restore complete isomorphism identification whereas without constants the whole infinite family collapses to one counting-free FO2 theory. It includes an exact partition-valued theory census and a sharp FO1-versus-FO2 distinction.
residual_risks: The classification is family-relative, not a statement about arbitrary finite graphs or counting logic.

limitations: Three internally vertex-disjoint paths only, each length >=2.
The bound on number of variables concerns counting-free FO with fixed terminal constants, not metric dimension.
